text:
Nora: quick sync on Optimize toolkit pilot / gating. want to nail pilot sizing, success metrics, and what we require infra-wise before any customer opt-ins.
Priya: +1. i think we need 3 distinct pilot profiles: low-latency web, high-throughput batch, and strict-accuracy regulated customers. different recs will matter per profile.
Tom: agree. propose target pilot customers = 4 total (1 per profile + 1 wildcard). keep pilot comitted <= 10 qps to start, with load tests up to 50 qps.
Ravi: infra note  we add quant recommendations we must record per-request telemetry: model_id, quant_profile, token_count, inference_ms. lightweight headers ok: `x-rw-model`, `x-rw-quant`, `x-rw-latency-ms`.
devops-bot: smoke: optimize-telemetry-proxy staging build succeeded at 2024-11-09T09:03Z :white_check_mark:
Claire: acceptance metrics idea:
- quality: no more than 1.5% delta vs baseline on sentinel queries (weighted by freq)
- latency: p99 within profile target (e.g., web=200ms, batch=700ms)
- cost: per-request token cost delta < +15% vs baseline during pilot
Priya: also require manual recovery path documented: how to disable recommendations for a tenant and pin model/quant. that must be one-click in Console for pilot customers.
Nora: rollout gates (must pass all):
1) Telemetry: headers + storage of eval run id (`eval_id`) in alert payloads.
2) Advisor UI: readonly recommendations list + export to csv.
3) Ops playbook: runbook + automatic incident draft creation.
4) Autosafety: safety profiles and a global cost-throttle to prevent runaway spend.
Tom: on safety profiles, small schema suggestion: 
``nprofile:name=string;auto_apply=bool;max_p99_ms=int;max_cost_increase_pct=int;fallback_variant=string``
we can store as simple k=v pairs in tenant-config.
Ravi: risk: if auto_apply=true + fallback_variant is larger model, costs could spike. require an approval step unless tenant-grade==enterprise.
Claire: evaluation alerts: plan for two alert severities: WARN (single-run drift) and CRIT (sustained over window). alerts must include: failing prompts (top 5), metric delta, `eval_url`, suggestedmitigations (revert, tighten prompt, disable quant).
Priya: also need a small DSL for alert windows so customers can tweak sensitivity. lightweight example: 
``nalert_rule: id=drift_small;metric=exact_match_rate;delta=-0.02;window=3d;severity=WARN;actions=[notify, suggest_revert]``
Nora: operationally, we should run internal chaos tests where recommendations are mis-applied to 5% of traffic to validate rollback. schedule for staging.
Tom: timeline thoughts: week 0-1 implement headers + telemetry + basic Advisor read-only UI. week 2 run internal chaos + telemetry analysis. week 3 soft invite pilot customers.
Ravi: telemetry retention for pilot: raw eval traces 30d, aggregated metrics 90d. need to confirm storage cost but ok for pilot.
Claire: pilot success checklist (short):
- 3 pilot customers onboarded and using Advisor recommendations
- no CRIT alerts during pilot or CRITs handled with documented timeline < 2h
- performance metrics within profile targets
- docs + 1-pager for customers about how to opt-out
Priya: prioritization: block on (A) headers + telemetry (infra), (B) Advisor UI readonly + export (product), (C) DSL + alert plumbing (eng/ops).
Nora: assign owners: infra=Ravi, product=Priya, ops=Tom, research=Claire. sync Wed EOD to review first PRs.
Tom: minor: please add a metric to track "recommendation-apply-rate" (how often customers click apply vs view) so we can measure product value.
Nora: good call. add `recommendation_apply_rate` to dashboard.
Priya: i'll draft the pilot invitation email and onboarding checklist after Wed sync.
Ravi: will open PR for header patches to proxy today.
devops-bot: test-deploy: telemetry-proxy canary scheduled for 2024-11-10T02:00Z :rocket:
Nora: excellent. last note: keep Advisor auto-apply off for GA unless we prove safety in pilot. all agreed?
All: :thumbsup:
